name: Abir Rahi
summary: I am a computer science graduate with experience in technology operations, software development, technical instruction, and hands-on infrastructure projects. I use Lens on Security to keep building practical security skills and explain what I learn clearly.
whyTitle: Security is easier to understand when you can see it.
whyBody: I created Lens on Security to connect ordinary photographs with cybersecurity concepts. A building, a road, a lock, or a set of pillars can reveal something about identity, networks, resilience, monitoring, and the decisions that keep systems safe.

This site is both a learning journal and a place to practice communicating security clearly. Each article starts with something visible and uses it as a path into the less visible systems that shape our digital lives.
